trigger: tracked command-delivery harness or skill change is ready for validation

steps.action: Run dependency-free skill and harness tests.
Run focused PowerShell completeness and skill validators.
On Windows, execute the actual CMD entrypoint from a detached path containing spaces.
Run documentation and diff hygiene checks.
Run the opt-in pre-commit hook against staged changes.

failurePolicy: Preserve the first failing artifact, repair its owning layer, and rerun the complete affected entrypoint; do not promote an inner-layer pass.
proofCeiling: Tracked contract, exact tested wrapper in the observed Windows environment, and repository hygiene only.
